text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there are any fun videos to watch~~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —Whoaaa!? We're bungee jumping from a place this high!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That bungee jumping special was amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo got so absorbed in watching videos that she ended up staying up late...
